list.name: sites
list.label: Sucursales
list.query: SELECT store_name AS __text, store_id AS __value FROM sites WHERE status = 'operational' ORDER BY store_name

panels.title: Tráfico por sucursal y día
panels.description: Tráfico (visitantes) por sucursal (filas) y fecha (eje X). Color = intensidad. Hover = número del día.

targets.rawSql: SELECT (c.bucket_day::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'America/Argentina/Buenos_Aires') AS time, SUM(c.ins) FILTER (WHERE s.store_name='Abasto') AS "Abasto", SUM(c.ins) FILTER (WHERE s.store_name='Alto Avellaneda') AS "Alto Avellaneda", SUM(c.ins) FILTER (WHERE s.store_name='Alto Comahue') AS "Alto Comahue", SUM(c.ins) FILTER (WHERE s.store_name='Alto Palermo') AS "Alto Palermo", SUM(c.ins) FILTER (WHERE s.store_name='Córdoba Shopping') AS "Córdoba Shopping", SUM(c.ins) FILTER (WHERE s.store_name='Los Gallegos') AS "Los Gallegos", SUM(c.ins) FILTER (WHERE s.store_name='Mendoza Plaza') AS "Mendoza Plaza", SUM(c.ins) FILTER (WHERE s.store_name='Unicenter') AS "Unicenter" FROM counting_by_bucket_day c JOIN sites s USING (store_id) WHERE c.store_id IN (${sites:sqlstring}) AND c.bucket_day BETWEEN $__timeFrom()::date AND $__timeTo()::date GROUP BY c.bucket_day ORDER BY time

panels.title: Visitantes por día de la semana × hora
panels.description: Visitantes por día de la semana (filas) y hora del día (columnas), promediados sobre el rango seleccionado (con 7 días = el valor de cada día; con rangos más largos = el patrón típico). Celdas coloreadas por intensidad.

targets.rawSql: WITH d AS (SELECT extract(isodow FROM bucket_hour AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::int AS dow, extract(hour FROM bucket_hour AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::int AS hr, ins AS tot FROM counting_by_bucket_hour WHERE store_id IN (${sites:sqlstring}) AND bucket_hour BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()) SELECT CASE dow WHEN 1 THEN 'Lun' WHEN 2 THEN 'Mar' WHEN 3 THEN 'Mié' WHEN 4 THEN 'Jue' WHEN 5 THEN 'Vie' WHEN 6 THEN 'Sáb' WHEN 7 THEN 'Dom' END AS "Día", COALESCE(ROUND(AVG(tot) FILTER (WHERE hr=10)),0) AS "10:00",COALESCE(ROUND(AVG(tot) FILTER (WHERE hr=11)),0) AS "11:00",COALESCE(ROUND(AVG(tot) FILTER (WHERE hr=12)),0) AS "12:00",COALESCE(ROUND(AVG(tot) FILTER (WHERE hr=13)),0) AS "13:00",COALESCE(ROUND(AVG(tot) FILTER (WHERE hr=14)),0) AS "14:00",COALESCE(ROUND(AVG(tot) FILTER (WHERE hr=15)),0) AS "15:00",COALESCE(ROUND(AVG(tot) FILTER (WHERE hr=16)),0) AS "16:00",COALESCE(ROUND(AVG(tot) FILTER (WHERE hr=17)),0) AS "17:00",COALESCE(ROUND(AVG(tot) FILTER (WHERE hr=18)),0) AS "18:00",COALESCE(ROUND(AVG(tot) FILTER (WHERE hr=19)),0) AS "19:00",COALESCE(ROUND(AVG(tot) FILTER (WHERE hr=20)),0) AS "20:00",COALESCE(ROUND(AVG(tot) FILTER (WHERE hr=21)),0) AS "21:00",COALESCE(ROUND(AVG(tot) FILTER (WHERE hr=22)),0) AS "22:00" FROM d GROUP BY dow ORDER BY dow

panels.title: Tráfico por hora según día de la semana
panels.description: Perfil horario (00-23) del tráfico promedio, una línea por día de la semana, agregado de las sucursales seleccionadas.

targets.rawSql: SELECT g AS "Hora", round(AVG(h.ins) FILTER (WHERE h.dow=1),0) AS "Lunes", round(AVG(h.ins) FILTER (WHERE h.dow=2),0) AS "Martes", round(AVG(h.ins) FILTER (WHERE h.dow=3),0) AS "Miércoles", round(AVG(h.ins) FILTER (WHERE h.dow=4),0) AS "Jueves", round(AVG(h.ins) FILTER (WHERE h.dow=5),0) AS "Viernes", round(AVG(h.ins) FILTER (WHERE h.dow=6),0) AS "Sábado", round(AVG(h.ins) FILTER (WHERE h.dow=7),0) AS "Domingo" FROM generate_series(10,22) g LEFT JOIN ( SELECT extract(hour FROM bucket_hour AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::int hr, extract(isodow FROM (bucket_hour AT TIME ZONE 'UTC'))::int dow, ins FROM counting_by_bucket_hour WHERE store_id IN (${sites:sqlstring}) AND bucket_hour BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()) h ON h.hr=g GROUP BY g ORDER BY g

panels.title: Dispositivos únicos por día (WiFi/BLE)
panels.description: Cantidad de dispositivos distintos detectados por día tras stitching local del device (un dispositivo con N rotaciones de MAC cuenta como 1).

targets.rawSql: SELECT to_char(bucket_day,'DD/MM') AS "Día", SUM(visitors) AS "Dispositivos únicos" FROM wifi_ble_by_bucket_day WHERE store_id IN (${sites:sqlstring}) AND bucket_day BETWEEN $__timeFrom()::date AND $__timeTo()::date GROUP BY bucket_day ORDER BY bucket_day

panels.title: Repetición intra-día (engagement)
panels.description: Distribución de dispositivos según cuántas ventanas de 15 min los observaron. 1 ventana = pasaron rápido; 3+ ventanas = rondaron o se quedaron cerca — proxy de engagement.

targets.rawSql: SELECT CASE windows_bucket WHEN '1' THEN '1 ventana' WHEN '2' THEN '2 ventanas' WHEN '3-5' THEN '3-5 ventanas' ELSE '6+ ventanas' END AS "Ventanas", SUM(visitors) AS "Dispositivos" FROM wifi_engagement_by_bucket_day WHERE store_id IN (${sites:sqlstring}) AND bucket_day BETWEEN $__timeFrom()::date AND $__timeTo()::date GROUP BY windows_bucket ORDER BY MIN(CASE windows_bucket WHEN '1' THEN 1 WHEN '2' THEN 2 WHEN '3-5' THEN 3 ELSE 6 END)

panels.title: Composición por rango de estatura estimada
panels.description: Distribución de los ingresos por rango de estatura estimada, a partir de la altura obtenida por visión estéreo. La categoría «Sin estimar» corresponde a los ingresos en que la profundidad estéreo no permitió estimar la estatura con confianza suficiente; al incluirla, los porcentajes se calculan sobre el total de ingresos y no sobre el subconjunto medible. Métrica de contexto, no accionable por la operación.

targets.rawSql: SELECT SUM(ins_adult) AS "Estatura ≥ 1,55 m", SUM(ins_child) AS "Estatura < 1,55 m", SUM(ins_unknown) AS "Sin estimar" FROM counting_by_bucket_day WHERE store_id IN (${sites:sqlstring}) AND bucket_day BETWEEN $__timeFrom()::date AND $__timeTo()::date

panels.title: Duración promedio de visita por día
panels.description: Permanencia promedio estimada por la Ley de Little (ocupación ÷ arribos), del total seleccionado, por día. Métrica de contexto/experiencia.

targets.rawSql: SELECT to_char(bucket_day,'DD/MM') AS "Día", round((SUM(visit_duration_minutes*arrivals)/NULLIF(SUM(arrivals),0))::numeric,1) AS "Duración (min)" FROM visit_duration_by_bucket_day WHERE store_id IN (${sites:sqlstring}) AND bucket_day BETWEEN $__timeFrom()::date AND $__timeTo()::date GROUP BY bucket_day ORDER BY bucket_day

panels.title: Semana vs fin de semana
panels.description: Reparto de visitantes entre días de semana (Lun–Vie) y fin de semana (Sáb–Dom) en el rango seleccionado.

targets.rawSql: SELECT SUM(ins) FILTER (WHERE extract(isodow FROM bucket_day)<=5) AS "Semana", SUM(ins) FILTER (WHERE extract(isodow FROM bucket_day)>=6) AS "Fin de semana" FROM counting_by_bucket_day WHERE store_id IN (${sites:sqlstring}) AND bucket_day BETWEEN $__timeFrom()::date AND $__timeTo()::date

target.rawSql: SELECT (holiday_date::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'America/Argentina/Buenos_Aires') AS time, name AS text FROM holidays WHERE holiday_date BETWEEN $__timeFrom()::date AND $__timeTo()::date ORDER BY holiday_date
